Original post text


Was thinking Friday only because Saturday would theoretically be a tougher ticket but ended up at Mates Of State. Then I went for the easiest and laziest option, a classical piano recital at a local library. But after 20 minutes of a camera click click click in my right ear by a painfully self unaware geezer I bailed and came here with only around $40 in my pocket but ended up finding a free ticket in a few minutes.

Fun to hang out and people watch either way. The only other musical act (I think) was Hemlocke Springs which was pretty good. People around me were really excited and noisy early on but I was in a good spot and it might not have intruded too much on the recording, which I heard about a combined 6 seconds of in 3 different spots.

Enjoy!
